description: This file defines the FilterParams class in the OrangeHRM project, which encapsulates filtering parameters such as sorting order, sort field, limit, and offset for queries or data retrieval. It includes getters and setters for these properties, with validation to ensure proper sort order values.

classes.name: FilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that encapsulates filtering parameters such as sorting order, sort field, limit, and offset for data retrieval operations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the current sorting order (ascending or descending).

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sorting order; validates that the input is either 'ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING', throws SearchParamException otherwise.

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Returns the current field used for sorting, or null if none is set.

methods.name: setSortField
methods.description: Sets the field used for sorting.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items to retrieve.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the limit for the number of items to retrieve.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the current offset (number of items to skip).

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset (number of items to skip).
